news.title: 4th-line wingers Klapka and Stromgren score to back Wolf in Flames' 2-1 win over Sharks
news.ruTitle: Вингеры 4-го звена Клапка и Стромгрен забивают, поддержав победу «Вулф ин Флэймз» над «Шаркс» со счетом 2:1.
news.description: — Fourth-line wingers Adam Klapka and William Stromgren scored, Dustin Wolf made 26 saves and the Calgary Flames beat the San Jose Sharks 2-1 on Monday night.

news.title: Kadri and Schwartz lead the Avalanche past the Blackhawks 5-2 for their 3rd straight win
news.ruTitle: Кадри и Шварц ведут «Эвеланш» над «Блэкхокс» со счетом 5–2 и одерживают третью победу подряд.
news.description: — Nazem Kadri and Jaden Schwartz scored two goals apiece, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the struggling Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Monday night for their third consecutive win.

news.title: Pastrnak scores lone shootout goal to give Bruins 3-2 win over Golden Knights
news.ruTitle: Пастрняк забил единственный гол в серии пенальти и принес Брюинз победу над Голден Найтс со счетом 3:2.
news.description: — David Pastrnak slipped a shot past Carter Hart to break a shootout stalemate and give the Boston Bruins a 3-2 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Monday night.

news.title: Detroit's Britta Curl-Salemme to miss PWHL season after announcing pregnancy

news.description: U.S. Olympian and PWHL Detroit forward Britta Curl-Salemme will miss the women's pro hockey season after announcing her pregnancy on Monday.

news.title: Faulk, Brandsegg-Nygård score early in 3rd, lift Red Wings past Panthers 5-3
news.ruTitle: Фолк, Брандсегг-Нюгорд забивают в начале третьего места и выводят «Ред Уингз» за победу над «Пантерс» со счетом 5–3.
news.description: — Justin Faulk and Michael Brandsegg-Nygård scored 45 seconds apart early in the third period, goalie Daniil Tarasov defeated his former team and the surging Detroit Red Wings beat the Florida Panthers 5-3 on Monday night.
